_doc: Internal project-rates catalog. ADMIN-ONLY. NEVER exposed to public site, AI chat, customer portal, or tech mode. Used exclusively by the project_proposal quote builder for commercial / install / lighting / renovation / change-order line items. Per-customer negotiated rates (customer.negotiatedRates) override these defaults at quote creation and snapshot onto the quote (quote.customRates). Excluded from scripts/lint-no-hardcoded-prices.mjs by file extension (the lint scanner only walks root-level .html). NEVER copy these into pricing.json — pricing.json is the public catalog and must remain so. Brief 1 (May 2026).
